description: This file defines the LocationServiceClient class for interacting with Amazon Location Service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies dynamically handled methods for various AWS Location Service operations, likely used as a client interface within the SDK.

classes.name: LocationServiceClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Location Service via AWS SDK for PHP. It inherits from AwsClient and provides method signatures for all supported service operations.

methods.name: associateTrackerConsumer
methods.description: Associates a tracker consumer with a tracker resource.

methods.name: batchDeleteDevicePositionHistory
methods.description: Deletes multiple device position history entries in a single call.

methods.name: batchEvaluateGeofences
methods.description: Evaluates a batch of geofences against device positions.

methods.name: batchGetDevicePosition
methods.description: Gets the current position of multiple devices.

methods.name: batchUpdateDevicePosition
methods.description: Updates the position of multiple devices.

methods.name: calculateRouteMatrix
methods.description: Calculates a matrix of routes between multiple points.

methods.name: describeGeofenceCollection
methods.description: Provides details about a geofence collection.

methods.name: describeKey
methods.description: Provides details about an API key.

methods.name: describeMap
methods.description: Provides details about a map resource.

methods.name: describePlaceIndex
methods.description: Provides details about a place index.

methods.name: describeRouteCalculator
methods.description: Provides details about a route calculator.

methods.name: disassociateTrackerConsumer
methods.description: Disassociates a tracker consumer from a tracker.

methods.name: forecastGeofenceEvents
methods.description: Predicts geofence events based on device positions.

methods.name: getDevicePosition
methods.description: Retrieves the latest position of a device.

methods.name: getDevicePositionHistory
methods.description: Retrieves historical positions of a device.

methods.name: getGeofence
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific geofence.

methods.name: getMapGlyphs
methods.description: Gets map glyphs for a style.

methods.name: getMapSprites
methods.description: Gets sprites for a map style.

methods.name: getMapStyleDescriptor
